cards.name: Iron Man
cards.description: On Reveal: Double the power of your other cards here.

cards.name: Wolverine
cards.description: When this is destroyed, return it to your hand with +2 power.

cards.name: Doctor Doom
cards.description: On Reveal: Add a 2-power Doombot to each other location.

cards.name: Killmonger
cards.description: On Reveal: Destroy all 1-Cost cards played this game, then gains +2 Power for each destroyed.

cards.name: Cosmo
cards.description: Ongoing: Ability text of cards can't trigger at this location.

cards.name: Enchantress
cards.description: On Reveal: Remove Ongoing abilities from all cards at this location.

cards.name: Shang-Chi
cards.description: On Reveal: Reduce the Power of each enemy card with Power 9 or more to 9.

cards.name: Jubilee
cards.description: On Reveal: Add a card from your deck to this location. It costs 1 less.

cards.name: Mister Fantastic
cards.description: Ongoing: Adjacent locations have +2 Power for you.

cards.name: Odin
cards.description: On Reveal: Activate the On Reveal ability of your other cards here again.

cards.name: Leader
cards.description: On Reveal: Copy the On Reveal ability of a random card in your opponent's deck, then use it.

cards.name: Galactus
cards.description: On Reveal: Destroy all cards at other locations, then fills them with 6-Power Asteroids.

cards.name: Knull
cards.description: On Reveal: Gains +2 Power for each card in all discard piles.

cards.name: Zabu
cards.description: Ongoing: Your 1-Cost cards cost 1 less (but not less than 1).

cards.name: Ebony Maw
cards.description: Ongoing: Your other cards here cost 1 more.

cards.name: Sera
cards.description: Ongoing: Your On Reveal abilities also happen one turn later, again.

cards.name: America Chavez
cards.description: Ongoing: You always draw non-Card Draw cards first.

cards.name: Hela
cards.description: On Reveal: Return all cards in both discard piles to play, at random locations.

cards.name: Devil Dinosaur
cards.description: Ongoing: Gains +2 Power for each card in your hand.

cards.name: Nova
cards.description: On Reveal: Give +1 Power to a random card in your hand.
